shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole surface
head with an elaborate headdress/crown at the top
vertical elongated composition of a single figure
justification: Both show a single upright anthropomorphic figure filling the field, with a distinct headdress or crown crowning the head at the top, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. Everything specific differs: A is a naturalistic profile figure with beard, pleated robe, spear gripped in both hands and slung quiver, while B is a frontal, blocky, schematic figure whose body is covered with abstract discs, arcs and paired motifs rather than held objects or clothing folds.
